title: odontites luteus subsp. bonifaciensis
intro: Odontites luteus subsp. bonifaciensis, commonly known as the golden odontites, is a plant species within the family Orobanchaceae, known for its unique characteristics and potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of golden odontites include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
